report.summary: Reviewed chunk 3 of 4 of subprocess_adapter.py. Found methods for stdin writing, sending messages, publishing events, event streaming, and line parsing. Claims about timeout handling and event parsing are verified. No external file references.
risks: _write_stdin | medium | Writes text plus newline to stdin; assumes the subprocess expects newline-terminated input. If the subprocess uses a different protocol, this may cause issues. | Check subprocess stdin protocol.
send | medium | Converts non-string messages to JSON; if message is already a JSON string, it will be double-encoded. | Review usage of send with string messages.
events | medium | Uses asyncio.wait_for with timeout; if remaining is very small, the timeout may fire prematurely. | Verify timeout handling in edge cases.
events | medium | stderr is captured by a task and decoded; if task fails, stderr may be empty. | Ensure stderr_task is robust.
events | medium | Session timeout is checked before each readline; if readline returns quickly, timeout may still be reached due to accumulated time. | Confirm timeout logic is as intended.
_parse_line | low | Falls back to TextDelta on JSON decode failure; if the line is intentionally not JSON, this is fine. | No action.
_parse_typed_event | low | Only handles a subset of event types; unknown types are ignored (return None). | Ensure all expected event types are handled.

observations.what: Method _write_stdin writes text plus newline; assumes subprocess expects newline-terminated input.
Method send converts non-string messages to JSON; if message is already a JSON string, it will be double-encoded.
Method events uses asyncio.wait_for with timeout; if remaining is very small, timeout may fire prematurely.
Method events captures stderr via a task; if task fails, stderr may be empty.
Method events checks timeout before each readline; if readline returns quickly, timeout may still be reached due to accumulated time.
Method _parse_line falls back to TextDelta on JSON decode failure; this is fine.
Method _parse_typed_event only handles a subset of event types; unknown types are ignored (return None).
